narrative.overview:
Subus draws the next thirty days as a transit strip map. Today is the station you are at, on the left of a short horizontal line. Each upcoming charge is a station in its category's line colour. Below, the same charges hang off a vertical spine, grouped like the stops of a route. The world deliberately avoids the category default: a stack of rounded cards with brand-coloured logo tiles under a big total. There are no cards, boxes or row backgrounds in the panel. Hierarchy comes from scale and weight alone, and one large number answers "how long until the next charge".

The ground belongs to the system. The panel is a plain `NSPopover`: Liquid Glass on macOS 26, popover vibrancy on 14 and 15, and an opaque system popover under Reduce Transparency. Text uses semantic label colours, never hex inks. The only custom colours are the eight line colours, the eight monogram tiles, the rail grey, and one brand orange. Native controls carry everything interactive: the segmented control, search field, menu picker, switch, link buttons and borderless buttons.

Motion is stepped and minimal. When the day changes, the horizon slides one day left in two 90 ms steps with no easing, and it moves instantly under Reduce Motion. A lifted station grows. The other stations and rails recede by thinning; they never fade.
keyCharacteristics: A 360 pt column on a system-material ground, with semantic text colours.
Eight line colours. A line colour means a category and nothing else.
One brand orange (#E8590C). It is spent on "now": the menu-bar dot, today and tomorrow, the days figure at 0–1, and steep price rises.
Full ink (the label colour) on graphics is reserved for the today ring, the leg to the next station, and the next station's label.
Text never dims. Focus changes only graphics and a faint row highlight.
The Year window adds one card, two year figures and a neutral count ramp. The panel's rules stay as they are.

rules.name: The One Reserved Ink Rule
rules.body: In the panel, full label colour on graphics appears in only three places: the today ring, the leg from today to the next station (5 pt, or 6 pt under Increase Contrast), and the next station's label. Cluster counts, ticks and month labels are secondary ink.

rules.name: The Orange Is the Accent Rule
rules.body: No custom orange exists apart from #E8590C and its text variant; no category line is orange. The panel's custom orange means "now": the menu-bar dot, today and tomorrow, the days figure at 0–1, and steep price rises. In the Year window, it rings this week or this month and marks steep price rises. A new surface does not get the accent orange for emphasis, errors or decoration. Errors (the save-error banner, the editor's field and logo messages) use system red, `NSColor.systemRed`, never the accent or a line colour.

rules.name: The Line Means Category Rule
rules.body: A line colour on a station, spine, ring or bar always means the subscription's category. A subscription without a category rides the rail grey. Payment methods never take a line colour; their bars are secondary-label grey behind a card-shaped mark. Monogram tiles are the one separate use: a tile's colour is the subscription's own `colorIndex` (or a hash of its name), and two subscriptions may share one.

rules.name: The Text Never Dims Rule
rules.body: Hover, selection and focus change graphics (station size, stroke width) and the row highlight only. Text and amounts keep full opacity in every state. Even a pressed row button renders its label unchanged.

rules.name: The One Large Number Rule
rules.body: In the panel, the 44 pt days figure is the only display-size number. Totals stay at 17 pt or less.

rules.name: The System Owns the Ground Rule
rules.body: In the panel, one container owns the background: the `NSPopover`. Views paint no panel background, card surface or row fill. The Year window's one card is its named departure. The fallback hexes exist only for snapshots and contrast checks.

rules.name: The Window Card Rule
rules.body: In the Year window, the week grid (and the year card on the subscription page) sits on one card at 16 pt corners over the window ground. Cells and tiles are tone fills inside it. The panel stays card-free.

rules.name: The Two Year Figures Rule
rules.body: In the Year window, the year figure (28 pt) is the summary sum and the month figure (26 pt) is a tile's count. Titles stay at 22 pt or less. The panel keeps its one 44 pt days figure.

rules.name: The Counted Ink Rule
rules.body: In the Year window, full ink on graphics belongs to ramp step 4 and the selection ring. Step 4 is the top of a count ramp, not the "now" accent. The accent ring marks only this week or this month.

dos: Do get every stroke colour from `LinePalette.line(index, scheme)`: the tile set in light, the bright set in dark, and the rail for no category.
Do keep strokes at 3 pt and move them to 4 pt under Increase Contrast. Let receded graphics thin to 1.5 / 2 pt rather than fade.
Do use `accentText` for any accent text and `accent` (#E8590C) for accent graphics.
Do pair every colour state with words: "today" / "tomorrow", "Trial", "+33 %", the category name.
Do use tabular digits on every number, and keep amounts uncompressed and tight to the right margin.
Do let the `NSPopover` own the ground and use semantic label colours for text.
Do keep the editor and Settings native, inheriting only tiles and line swatches.
Do take the Year window's cell tones and tile text from `YearRamp` per step, appearance and Increase Contrast, and draw its rings outside the cell through a gap of the card ground.
Do step the horizon in two 90 ms unseasoned steps, and make it instant under Reduce Motion.
donts: Don't put cards, boxes, borders or row backgrounds in the panel. The 7 % / 11 % row highlight is the only fill.
Don't lower the opacity of text or amounts on hover, selection or press.
Don't give a payment method, an error, a state or a decoration a line colour.
Don't add another custom orange, or spend the accent outside "now" and steep price rises.
Don't put full label-colour ink on panel graphics other than the today ring, the leg, the next-station label and the lifted halo. In the Year window, only ramp step 4 and the selection ring take it.
Don't add a second large number to the panel. The 44 pt days figure is alone there; the Year window's 28 pt and 26 pt figures stay in that window.
Don't colour the Year grid's tone with a line colour or the accent. The count ramp is neutral.
Don't bundle third-party brand logos. Use a monogram tile, the user's image or the site's icon.
